title: Oracle Business Intelligence UploadFndDBCPage Arbitrary File Upload Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Oracle Business Intelligence. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the UploadFndDBCPage class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can allow the upload of arbitrary files. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
